points.title: 家族酿酒与童年教育
points.titleEn: Family Sake Brewing and Early Education
points.description: 盛田昭夫出生于日本名古屋一个拥有400年历史的酿酒世家。作为家中长子，他本应继承家族企业，但自幼对电子技术表现出浓厚兴趣。父亲开明地支持他的科学追求，送他到第八高等学校学习物理学。这段时期培养了他对精密工程的热爱，也为日后创立索尼奠定了思想基础。名古屋的工业环境和家族传统塑造了他注重品质与创新并重的价值观。
points.descriptionEn: Akio Morita was born in Nagoya to a family with a 400-year history of sake brewing. As the eldest son, he was expected to inherit the family business, but he showed early interest in electronics. His father supported his scientific pursuits, sending him to the Higher Eighth School to study physics. This period nurtured his passion for precision engineering, laying the foundation for what would become Sony. Nagoya's industrial environment and family traditions shaped his values of combining quality with innovation.

points.title: 战争岁月与物理学研究
points.description: 盛田昭夫毕业于帝国大学（现东京大学）物理系，随后在二战期间被征召入伍，担任海军技术军官，负责研究热制导导弹技术。战争结束后，他回到东京，与好友井深大在东京日本桥的百货公司仓库里创立了东京通信工业株式会社（即索尼前身）。这段经历让他深刻理解技术的重要性，以及将科研成果转化为民用产品的可能性，形成了索尼'技术立社'的核心理念。
points.descriptionEn: Morita graduated from Imperial University (now University of Tokyo) with a degree in physics. During World War II, he was commissioned as a naval technical officer, researching heat-seeking missile technology. After the war, he returned to Tokyo and co-founded Tokyo Tsushin Kogyo (later Sony) with Masaru Ibuka in a converted department store warehouse. This experience deepened his understanding of technology's importance and the potential of converting military research into consumer products, forming Sony's core principle of 'technology-driven business'.

points.title: 美国市场开拓之旅
points.description: 1953年，盛田昭夫首次赴美考察，敏锐地意识到美国市场的巨大潜力。他坚持公司必须国际化，反对当时日本企业只关注国内市场的保守观念。1958年，他将公司更名为索尼（Sony），这一名称源自'sonus'（拉丁语中的声音）和'sonny'（英语中的可爱孩子），象征着公司全球化愿景。在美国期间，他学习了西方商业文化，建立了广泛的商业网络，为索尼日后成为真正的跨国企业奠定了基础。这段经历也让他形成了独特的'全球本土化'经营理念。
points.descriptionEn: In 1953, Morita made his first trip to the United States, recognizing the immense potential of the American market. He insisted on internationalization, opposing the conservative view of Japanese businesses focusing only on domestic markets. In 1958, he renamed the company Sony, derived from 'sonus' (Latin for sound) and 'sonny' (English for little boy), symbolizing the company's global vision. During his time in America, he studied Western business culture, built extensive business networks, and laid the foundation for Sony's transformation into a truly multinational corporation. This experience shaped his unique 'glocalization' business philosophy.

points.title: 索尼崛起与产品创新
points.description: 作为索尼的总裁，盛田昭夫领导公司推出了一系列革命性产品。1960年，索尼推出世界上第一台晶体管收音机，开创了便携式电子产品时代；1968年，与索尼首席工程师岩间和夫共同开发了特丽珑显像管技术；1976年，推出Betamax录像机（尽管在与VHS的格式大战中最终失败）。这一时期，盛田昭夫强调'工程师文化'，鼓励创新思维，建立了索尼'做别人没做过的事'的企业精神。他注重产品质量和设计美学，使索尼成为高品质电子产品的代名词。
points.descriptionEn: As Sony's president, Morita led the company in launching a series of revolutionary products. In 1960, Sony introduced the world's first transistor radio, pioneering the era of portable electronics. In 1968, with Sony's chief engineer Kazuo Iwama, he developed Trinitron picture tube technology. In 1976, Sony launched the Betamax VCR (though it eventually lost the format war to VHS). During this period, Morita emphasized 'engineer culture,' encouraged innovative thinking, and established Sony's corporate spirit of 'doing what others haven't done.' He focused on product quality and design aesthetics, making Sony synonymous with high-end electronics.

points.title: 全球化扩张与战略转型
points.description: 1970年代后期，盛田昭夫将索尼业务扩展至全球，在美国、欧洲、亚洲等地建立生产基地和销售网络。1976年，索尼在美国圣地亚哥建立首个海外工厂；1988年，收购哥伦比亚唱片公司，进军娱乐产业，实现'硬件+内容'的战略布局。这一时期，盛田昭夫撰写了《日本可以说不》一书，表达日本企业应减少对美国依赖、增强自主性的观点。他积极推动日本企业国际化，成为日本战后经济奇迹的重要象征，被誉为'日本企业国际化之父'。
points.descriptionEn: In the late 1970s, Morita expanded Sony's operations globally, establishing production facilities and sales networks in America, Europe, and Asia. In 1976, Sony built its first overseas factory in San Diego, California. In 1988, Sony acquired Columbia Pictures, entering the entertainment industry and implementing a 'hardware + content' strategy. During this period, Morita co-authored the book 'Japan Can Say No,' expressing the view that Japanese businesses should reduce dependence on America and enhance their autonomy. He actively promoted the internationalization of Japanese companies, becoming a symbol of Japan's post-war economic miracle and earning the title 'Father of Japanese Corporate Internationalization.'

points.title: 晚年领导与遗产传承
points.description: 1990年代，盛田昭夫虽已退居二线，但仍积极参与索尼战略决策。1993年，他被诊断患有脑出血，1994年正式辞去董事长职务。尽管健康问题困扰，他仍致力于推动日美经济文化交流，担任日美经济关系委员会主席。1998年，出版自传《日本制造》，总结其商业哲学。1999年，盛田昭夫在东京逝世，享年78岁。他留下的不仅是索尼这一全球品牌，还有'创新、品质、全球化'的企业精神，以及'企业家应承担社会责任'的经营理念，对全球商业界产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In the 1990s, though having stepped back from daily operations, Morita remained actively involved in Sony's strategic decisions. In 1993, he was diagnosed with a cerebral hemorrhage, and in 1994, he officially resigned as chairman. Despite health challenges, he continued to promote Japan-US economic and cultural exchanges, serving as chairman of the Japan-US Economic Relations Council. In 1998, he published his autobiography 'Made in Japan,' summarizing his business philosophy. In 1999, Morita died in Tokyo at the age of 78. He left behind not only the global brand Sony but also a corporate spirit of 'innovation, quality, globalization' and the business philosophy that 'entrepreneurs should bear social responsibility,' profoundly influencing the global business community.

appraisal.zh: 盛田昭夫被视为日本战后经济奇迹的象征和索尼帝国的缔造者，他以创新打破常规，把小型电子公司发展为全球科技巨头，倡导工程师文化与全球化视野，建立'硬件+内容'模式并预见数字娱乐时代，学界视其为日本从模仿创新转向自主创新的关键人物，其'全球本土化'战略被广泛借鉴。也有研究者指出，他在Betamax格式之争中固执己见而失去家用录像机市场，过度倚重西方市场，收购哥伦比亚后的文化整合失利造成巨额亏损，《日本可以说不》的民族主义倾向亦受批评。
appraisal.en: Akio Morita is seen as a symbol of Japan's post-war economic miracle and architect of the Sony empire, breaking conventions to turn a small electronics firm into a global giant, advocating engineer culture and a global vision, and establishing a 'hardware plus content' model that foresaw the digital entertainment era; scholars regard him as key to Japan's shift from imitative to autonomous innovation, his 'glocalization' strategy widely borrowed. Yet researchers also note his stubbornness in the Betamax format war cost Sony the home video market, his overemphasis on Western markets, the failed cultural integration and huge losses after acquiring Columbia, and the nationalist tone of 'Japan Can Say No'.

supporter.zh: 盛田昭夫被誉为日本战后经济奇迹的象征，是索尼帝国的缔造者。他敢于创新，打破常规，将索尼从一家小型电子公司发展成为全球科技巨头。他倡导的'工程师文化'和'全球化视野'，使日本企业走向世界舞台。盛田昭夫不仅创造了众多革命性产品，更建立了'硬件+内容'的商业模式，预见了数字娱乐时代的到来。他坚持'做别人没做过的事'的企业精神，激励了无数创业者，被视为日本企业国际化的典范。
supporter.en: Akio Morita is celebrated as a symbol of Japan's post-war economic miracle and the architect of the Sony empire. He dared to innovate and break conventions, transforming Sony from a small electronics company into a global technology giant. The 'engineer culture' and 'global vision' he advocated propelled Japanese enterprises onto the world stage. Morita not only created numerous revolutionary products but also established the 'hardware + content' business model, foreseeing the arrival of the digital entertainment era. His corporate spirit of 'doing what others haven't done' has inspired countless entrepreneurs, making him a model for Japanese corporate internationalization.

critic.zh: 批评者认为盛田昭夫的决策存在明显失误，如Betamax与VHS的格式大战中固执己见，导致索尼失去整个家用录像机市场。他过度强调西方市场，忽视了亚洲其他地区的潜力。在收购哥伦比亚唱片公司后，索尼的文化整合并不成功，导致巨额亏损。此外，《日本可以说不》一书中的民族主义倾向也受到批评。有观点认为，盛田昭夫的个人崇拜掩盖了索尼集体创新精神的衰退，他退居二线后，索尼逐渐失去了创新活力，陷入长期困境。
critic.en: Critics argue that Morita's decisions had significant flaws, such as his stubborn stance in the Betamax vs. VHS format war, which led Sony to lose the entire home video recorder market. He overemphasized Western markets while neglecting the potential of other Asian regions. After acquiring Columbia Pictures, Sony's cultural integration was unsuccessful, resulting in huge losses. Additionally, the nationalist tone in his book 'Japan Can Say No' has been criticized. Some argue that Morita's cult of personality masked the decline of Sony's collective innovative spirit. After stepping back, Sony gradually lost its innovative vitality and fell into long-term difficulties.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，盛田昭夫被视为日本战后经济转型期的关键人物，代表了从模仿创新到自主创新的转变。流行文化中，他常被描绘为'日本制造'的象征，体现了日本战后经济奇迹。他的商业理念影响了全球企业管理，特别是'全球本土化'战略被广泛借鉴。盛田昭夫的一生反映了日本企业在全球化进程中的机遇与挑战，他的成功与失误都成为商业研究的经典案例。尽管存在争议，但他对电子工业和全球商业模式的贡献不可否认，其遗产至今仍在科技和商业领域产生深远影响。
objective.en: In historical scholarship, Morita is regarded as a key figure in Japan's post-war economic transformation, representing the shift from imitative innovation to autonomous innovation. In popular culture, he is often depicted as a symbol of 'Made in Japan,' embodying Japan's post-war economic miracle. His business philosophy has influenced global corporate management, particularly the 'glocalization' strategy that has been widely adopted. Morita's life reflects the opportunities and challenges Japanese enterprises faced during globalization, with both his successes and failures becoming classic case studies in business. Despite controversies, his contributions to the electronics industry and global business models are undeniable, and his legacy continues to have a profound impact in technology and business today.

self.zh: 我从不考虑市场份额，我只考虑如何创造人们想要的产品。
self.en: I never think about the market. I only think about making products that people want.
